text:
oliver: thanks for the all-hands discussion. quick follow-up: can we consolidate RCA link + discrete actions so leadership can track?
maria: RCA is live -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-2026-14. brief: autoscaler mis-evaluated load signals causing cascading placement failures.
sam: i'll take the immediate mitigation (scale policy rollback + surge buffer). aiming to complete and smoke in 36h, will post updates in #eng-sre.
carmen: i'll draft a short customer impact note and suggested communication slate. target: EOD tomorrow. pls ping me with any impact windows.
ops-bot: incident-log 2026-07-22T09:18Z recorded.
mar ia: i've added actions to the ops tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/action-tracker row 78. summary: 1) emergency surge buffer (owner: sam) due 36h; 2) config validation guard (owner: oliver) due 24h; 3) customer note (owner: carmen) due EOD tomorrow; 4) long-term fix (owner: eng-infra) due sprint 28.
sam: quick checklist i'm using included in RCA for oncall:
```
# rollback policy
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/autoscaler AUTOSCALE_MODE=stable
# validate
kubectl -n redwood get hpa | grep autoscaler
```
oliver: can folks drop quick status updates in this thread? leadership asked for a 72h readout slide.
carmen: noted. i'll co-author the slide with sam. deadline 72h.
sam: updating: surge buffer deployed to canary region at 2026-07-22T11:05Z, smoke tests passing.
maria: I'll add the postmortem slide to next all-hands deck once it's ready.
oliver: thanks everyone, syncing tomorrow 9am PT to check blockers.
